def _affine(x, y, prior):
    """Return the best local affine fit and whether the checks identify it."""
    if len(x) < 2 or np.ptp(x) < 0.05:
        return (np.array([prior[0], np.median(y - prior[0] * x) if len(x) else prior[1]]), False)
    a, b = np.triu_indices(len(x), k=1)
    sep = np.abs(x[a] - x[b]) >= max(0.05, 0.05 * np.ptp(x))
    a, b = (a[sep], b[sep])
    gain = (y[b] - y[a]) / (x[b] - x[a])
    bias = y[a] - gain * x[a]
    residual = np.abs(y - gain[:, None] * x - bias[:, None])
    h = max(2, len(x) // 2 + 1)
    score = (np.sort(residual, axis=1)[:, :h] ** 2).sum(axis=1)
    support = (residual <= 0.001).sum(axis=1)
    if support.max() < h or h == 2:
        candidates = np.flatnonzero(support == support.max())
        delta = (gain[candidates] - prior[0]) * max(1.0, np.ptp(x))
        best = candidates[np.argmin(delta ** 2 + (bias[candidates] - prior[1]) ** 2)]
    else:
        best = np.argmin(score)
    err = residual[best]
    clean = err <= max(0.001, min(0.005, 5 * np.median(err)))
    A = np.column_stack((x[clean], np.ones(clean.sum())))
    fit = np.linalg.lstsq(A, y[clean], rcond=None)[0]
    identified = clean.sum() >= max(h, 3) and np.ptp(x[clean]) >= 0.1 and (fit[0] > 0)
    return (fit, identified)

def _alignment(train, test):
    labs = np.r_[train['lab_id'], test['lab_id']]
    strata = np.r_[train['stratum'], test['stratum']]
    refs = np.concatenate((train['ref_coupons'], test['ref_coupons']))
    raw = np.concatenate((train['coupon_features_raw'], test['coupon_features_raw']))
    for lab in np.unique(labs):
        m = labs == lab
        panel = refs[m]
        cols = np.sum(np.isfinite(panel), axis=0) >= 2
        if np.any(cols):
            center = np.median(np.nanmean(panel[:, cols], axis=0))
            scale = np.median(np.nanstd(panel[:, cols], axis=0))
            raw[m] = (raw[m] - center) / (scale if scale > 0 else 1.0)
    _, cell = np.unique(np.column_stack((labs, strata)), axis=0, return_inverse=True)
    finite = np.isfinite(raw)
    counts = np.zeros((int(cell.max()) + 1, raw.shape[1]))
    sums = np.zeros_like(counts)
    np.add.at(counts, cell, finite)
    np.add.at(sums, cell, np.where(finite, raw, 0.0))
    means = np.divide(sums, counts, out=np.zeros_like(sums), where=counts > 0)
    available = (counts > 0).sum(axis=0)
    fill = means.sum(axis=0) / np.maximum(1, available)
    x = np.where(finite, raw, fill)
    n = len(train['lab_id'])
    return (x[:n], x[n:])

def _design(taus, hist, hold, cov, dt, time):
    tail = np.r_[np.cumsum(dt[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.0]
    q = dt[:, None] / taus
    memory = np.exp(-tail[:, None] / taus) * -np.expm1(-q)
    jump = hold[:, None] - hist @ memory
    drift = cov[:, None, :] * time[None, :, None]
    relax = jump[:, None, :] * -np.expm1(-time[:, None] / taus)
    return (np.concatenate((relax, drift), axis=2), np.column_stack((jump / taus, cov)))

def _consensus(x, y, prior):
    """Fit a positive-slope affine map to the best-supported local checks."""
    if len(x) < 3 or np.ptp(x) < 0.1:
        return None
    i, j = np.triu_indices(len(x), 1)
    ok = np.abs(x[j] - x[i]) >= 0.1
    i, j = (i[ok], j[ok])
    slopes = (y[j] - y[i]) / (x[j] - x[i])
    offsets = y[i] - slopes * x[i]
    error = np.abs(y - slopes[:, None] * x - offsets[:, None])
    inliers = error <= 0.001
    support = inliers.sum(axis=1)
    candidates = np.flatnonzero((support >= max(3, len(x) // 2 + 1)) & (slopes > 0))
    if not candidates.size:
        return None
    candidates = candidates[support[candidates] == support[candidates].max()]
    loss = np.minimum(error[candidates], 0.001).sum(axis=1)
    delta = (slopes[candidates] - prior[0]) ** 2 + (offsets[candidates] - prior[1]) ** 2
    best = candidates[np.lexsort((delta, loss))[0]]
    keep = inliers[best]
    return np.linalg.lstsq(np.column_stack((x[keep], np.ones(keep.sum()))), y[keep], rcond=None)[0]

def _crossing(time, initial, strain, critical):
    grid = np.r_[0.0, time]
    distance = np.column_stack((initial, strain)) - critical[:, None]
    reached = distance >= 0
    first = np.argmax(reached, axis=1)
    crossing = np.full(len(initial), time[-1])
    crossing[reached[:, 0]] = 0.0
    i = np.flatnonzero(first > 0)
    j = first[i]
    before, after = (distance[i, j - 1], distance[i, j])
    crossing[i] = grid[j - 1] - before / (after - before) * (grid[j] - grid[j - 1])
    return crossing
